content: Netflix Conductor: state-machine-based orchestrator (Decider service) giving visibility/control across service task coordination; at-least-once task delivery guarantee. AWS Step Functions: fully managed state machine service (Amazon States Language, JSON) with automatic error retries, sequential/parallel/branching transitions, human-in-the-loop via task tokens + callback pattern (pause up to a year awaiting external callback), deep CloudWatch/X-Ray observability integration. Both are server/service-based, not embedded libraries.
